explanation: A coup needs something to overthrow. The coup of 28 May 1926 overthrew this parliament and the government drawn from it. The edge claims that and no more. It does not claim that the ballot of November 1925 caused the coup, because the case against the Republic rested on fifteen years of instability rather than on this result. The election is worth a record for what the coup then made of it. The Chamber elected in 1925 was the last chosen from more than one list for fifty years, and everything the atlas holds between here and 1975 follows from that.
